Customer churn (monthly)

DescriptionShare of accounts paying at the start of a month that cancelled during it. Paused accounts are not churned.
StatusApproved
Last editedSep 26

SQL exampleSQL

WITH starting AS (
  SELECT account_id
  FROM analytics.core.accounts_monthly
  WHERE month = @month
    AND status = 'paying'
),
churned AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT account_id
  FROM analytics.product.events
  WHERE event_name = 'subscription_cancelled'
)
SELECT COUNT(churned.account_id)
  / COUNT(starting.account_id) AS monthly_churn_rate
FROM starting
LEFT JOIN churned USING (account_id)

Define churn once for finance reporting

Finance reported August churn as 3.1% and 4.6%. One query counted paused accounts as churned.

2 changes · applied together

  1. LocationKnowledge / Workspace / Finance / Churn reporting

    Open current version ↗Show full content

    Ready to apply to the current page

    How we report churn

    Report monthly churn as cancelled subscriptions divided by all subscriptions. the Customer churn (monthly) metric. Paused accounts are not churned.
